facts.value: It is extremely important that you submit the documents required for the issuance of your I-20 to us. Upload the required documents through My ASU.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

facts.value: The upload tool on My ASU only allows the upload of each document type once, so please ensure you have all your documents ready before uploading.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

facts.value: If you upload financial documents that do not cover the full funding needed as shown on the financial guarantee, you will be asked to submit additional documentation to demonstrate the full funding, which will delay the issuance of your I-20.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

facts.value: Once you have received your I-20, be sure to pay your I-901 fee. Once the fee has been paid do not delay in contacting your consulate to obtain a visa appointment.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

facts.value: Some consulates may have long wait times, so do not delay on securing an appointment time.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

facts.value: If you are unable to submit the documentation needed to receive an I-20 from ASU or are unable to obtain your F1 visa in time to arrive by the start of the semester of your admission, contact [email protected] and we can advise you on your options.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

facts.value: View the I-20 Frequently Asked Questions webpage for more information.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

facts.value: Check wait times for your local embassy or consulate, as some areas may be experiencing wait times longer than 30 days.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

facts.value: You can now apply for your visa up to 365 days before the start date listed on your I-20.
